verdict.one_liner: TMST-7700 = TD 6.2.3 phy flow's new 'Run Timing Status Checker' stage (Tcl check_timing, SDC health/completeness) surface as a CRITICAL-WARNING DRC; the number is the count of severity=HIGH items in the check_timing report. Same SDC (byte-identical across 1333/1600ctl/002820) produced 0 on 6.2.2 logs and 1/4/4 on both 6.2.3 candidates => tool-version behavior, not a new-IP defect and not an SDC syntax error.
verdict.detail_items_summary: flow count 4 = 3 local clocks (clock definition: config_inst.cwc_tck_o / mclk27 / mipi_a_byte_clk) + 1 PLL frequency rounding mismatch (pclkx5 742.400024 vs 742.500000 MHz); additional HIGH findings not counted by the flow counter: dummy_node=3 groups (DDR PHY bankref / MIPI rdiff_enb pads / CWC watch_pipe+debug residue); substantive classes (no_clock / combinational loops / invalid constraint / generated-clock-disconnected) all 0
verdict.detail_items_reason: enumerated in the 2026-10-17 evening G-2 follow-up (see detail_enumeration): check_timing -file executed on a private copy of the routed/place db; candidate byte-identical before/after (zero-write proof)
verdict.bit_validity_impact: none direct (CRITICAL-WARNING did not block flow; route/bitgen exit 0; bitgen preconditions met; message does not alter bit content)
verdict.sta_impact: does not overturn zero-violation results; leaves a small completeness caveat only if any of the 4 HIGH items marks a truly unconstrained path (to be excluded by the follow-up enumeration); FOLLOW-UP DONE: enumeration found no substantive class (no_clock/loops/invalid all 0) -> caveat closed; recommend closing M5.7

rationale: Message semantics: count of check_timing severity=HIGH items (SWUG117 appendix definition) - a constraint-completeness report surfaced as DRC CRITICAL-WARNING; not a timing violation
Appears identically on new-IP (1333) and old-IP (1600ctl) candidates under 6.2.3 => not a new-IP defect
SDC byte-identical across 6.2.2 baseline and both 6.2.3 candidates => not caused by constraint edits; no SDC syntax error (no USR-8001/Tcl errors)
6.2.3 flow engine adds 'Run Timing Status Checker' stage (runs 3x per route) and the TMST DRC family + message template; 6.2.2 engine has none of these and its logs are silent
Rule already documented in 6.2.2-era docs (User Guide 2026-05) but not wired into the 6.2.2 flow => documentation-first, flow-enabled-in-6.2.3
Count changes 1 (place) -> 4 (route/final) => some checks become evaluable/added after routing; consistent with a post-route completeness report
analysis.confidence: high for classification (new stricter check); detail of the 4 items unknown (not enumerated)

recommendations.action: No design/SDC/bit action in this batch; keep M1a (1333 mainline / 1600 fallback) and bit candidates unchanged; M5.7 open item is minimized (meaning + impact boundary) and does not block board phases

Enumerate the 4 HIGH items: import_db of the routed pr db then 'check_timing -file <repo scratch>\tmst7700_detail_<cand>.rpt' (or GUI Check Timing Report export). Direct output to a repo-side scratch path to avoid writing into candidates (writing into candidates requires planner approval). If all items are existing-style (no_input_delay/no_output_delay/dummy_node/clock_check) -> close M5.7 as 'existing constraint style + new check'. If no_clock/unexpandable/combinational_loops classes appear -> escalate to real constraint gap and plan fixes with the corresponding retest impact list
Low-priority vendor/FAE ticket only if confirmation of the 6.2.2(docs only)->6.2.3(flow-enabled) behavior change or asking for TMST detail auto-dump capability is desired; non-blocking

Do NOT add create_waiver for TMST-7700 or exclude check items (would hide completeness info and require touching frozen ADC/SDC); do NOT add set_input_delay/set_output_delay in-place (would change frozen comparison baseline; must be a new task with retest)
